title: Faint prints, toner low
user_description: Everything I print is coming out very light and faded. Is the printer broken?

options.why: A driver does not control how much toner is left. Faint prints are usually a supply problem.

options.text: Check the toner level and replace the toner cartridge if it is low
options.why: Faint or fading prints are a classic sign of low toner. Checking the level is quick and replacing the cartridge is the normal fix.
Network settings have nothing to do with print quality. The printer is clearly printing, so it is reaching the PC.

hints: Is the printer working but printing weakly, or not working at all?
What runs out in a laser printer over time?
real_world_tip: Ask when the cartridge was last replaced. Keeping one spare cartridge in stock saves a lot of waiting.
